view: Sijilmasa crumbling rammed-earth wall fragments at Tafilalt oasis, ground-level view through collapsed doorway toward date palms, warm adobe texture and windblown sand, low ruins no intact palace or obligatory caravan.

eras.title: Walls beside the palms
eras.caption: Sijilmasa stood at the northern end of important trans-Saharan routes. Its crumbling earthen walls remain among the palms of the Tafilalt oasis, where caravans once connected the Maghreb with trading centres south of the desert.
